title: THE OVERSEER SEES FARTHER
why: His note of 2026-10-14: THE OVERSEER was looking right at him and did not attack. Three faults, all fixed. First, its sight was a plain Warden sight of 62 meters; the boss now sees and shoots from 87 meters (1.4 times as far; a balance change, allowed by his ruling of 2026-10-02), and a plain Warden is unchanged. Second, the guard-the-lair rule of v17.45 turned its body toward home as soon as you stood more than 110 meters from its lair, so the shot it had begun to charge ran out facing away and never fired: it looked at you, charged and did nothing. Now, when it sees you inside its reach it holds where it stands, faces you and fires, and the lair rule only stops it chasing you out of its ground; out of its reach it walks home as before. Third, it looks left or right by its heading while it only saw in a narrow cone of that heading, so it could face you and not see you; it now sees whatever stands on the side it faces, with a clear line, and never through a wall. In a party the host runs it and either player can be seen and shot.
now: THE OVERSEER now sees and shoots from 87 meters instead of 62, and it fires at you from its ground even past its lair, so when it looks at you it is dangerous.
